expected: Offline, alter_column compiles nullability and comment changes to MODIFY/CHANGE with the full column definition (NULL, DEFAULT NULL and COMMENT '' stated explicitly), a dropped default to ALTER COLUMN c SET DEFAULT NULL (two MODIFY statements for a NOT NULL column), and a nullability change without existing_type raises ValueError. That is compiled-SQL evidence: whether 10.2, 11.0 and 11.2+ servers accept and keep the attributes is not verified without a live run, and the report must say so.
non_goals: no new Alembic operations and no change to type-only alter_column SQL
no claim that the migrations run on any CUBRID version unless a live run is recorded
problem: Alembic alter_column sends nullability, dropped-default and comment changes to Alembic's generic SQL, which CUBRID rejects: nullable= emits ALTER COLUMN c SET/DROP NOT NULL, server_default=None emits DROP DEFAULT, and comment= raises "can't render element of type ColumnComment". Route these changes through CUBRID's MODIFY/CHANGE (requiring existing_type), emit a dropped default CUBRID accepts, and document what alter_column needs. Server versions differ in whether MODIFY keeps an attribute it omits, so the SQL must state each attribute explicitly; that version behavior can only be confirmed on live servers.
title: Emit CUBRID-compatible SQL for nullability, dropped defaults and comments in Alembic alter_column
